name: Patagonia
about: Trekking season (Torres del Paine, El Chaltén) runs Nov–Mar when trails/refugios are open; winter shuts much of the infrastructure down.
overview: Windswept granite spires, glaciers, and steppe at the southern tip of South America, split between Chile and Argentina.
costOverview: Park entrance and transport are real costs, but food and coffee in gateway towns stay reasonable — the exception is the handful of luxury lodges deep in the park.
monthlyWeather: warming up fast, with wind picking up toward its summer peak
